import RNA, random, sys, time

target = "....((((..(((((..((((..((((.....))))((((((...))).)))))))((((((.((.((.(((((....)).)))))))(((((.((.((.((....))))))(((((.(((....)).))).)))..)).)))))).))))))))(((.(((.(((.((((....))))))))))((((((((...))).)).))).)))))))"
N = len(target)
assert N == 214

pair = [-1]*N
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pair[i]=j; pair[j]=i

# Start from parallel_search best
base = "AUAGCACGGUGUGGCCGAGCGAGACCGUAUUACGGUAGUAUCUUCGAUAACUCGCUAGGUGGUUGGACAGGGCUAACGAGACCCGUCAUUUUUGGCUUUCAUCGUCAUAAGCGCGUGCUCAUAGCUGAGUGUCGCUGAACGGACCAGCCUGCCGCAGAAAUUCACGACUCCAUUGGGAGCGUAAUGGAAGGCAAAAUGCACUCUCCUUCUCGUG"
assert len(base)==214

def fold(seq):
    fc = RNA.fold_compound(seq)
    ss, en = fc.mfe()
    return ss, en

best = base
bs, be = fold(best)
bd = RNA.bp_distance(bs, target)
print("start bd", bd, flush=True)
best_score = (-1000 if bd==0 else -bd) - (be if bd==0 else 0)

random.seed(1)
t0=time.time()
it=0
while time.time()-t0 < 150:
    it+=1
    r = random.random()
    if r < 0.6:
        # targeted: fix diff positions
        s = list(best)
        diffs = [i for i in range(N) if bs[i]!=target[i]]
        if diffs:
            n = random.randint(1, min(4, len(diffs)))
            for i in random.sample(diffs, n):
                if target[i]=='(' and pair[i]>=0:
                    s[i]='G'; s[pair[i]]='C'
                elif target[i]==')' and pair[i]>=0:
                    s[i]=random.choice(['C','G']); s[pair[i]]=random.choice(['G','C'])
                elif target[i]=='.':
                    s[i]=random.choice(['A','A','U'])
                else:
                    s[i]=random.choice('ACGU')
        cand=''.join(s)
    elif r < 0.8:
        cand=''.join([c if random.random()>0.03 else random.choice('ACGU') for c in best])
    else:
        # random single mutation
        s=list(best); i=random.randrange(N); s[i]=random.choice('ACGU'); cand=''.join(s)
    cs, ce = fold(cand)
    cd = RNA.bp_distance(cs, target)
    cscore = (-1000 if cd==0 else -cd) - (ce if cd==0 else 0)
    if cscore > best_score or (cscore==best_score and random.random()<0.2):
        best=cand; bs=cs; be=ce; bd=cd; best_score=cscore
    if it % 3000 == 0:
        print("it",it,"bd",bd,"time",round(time.time()-t0,1), flush=True)
    if bd==0:
        print("SOLVED", best, flush=True)
        break

print("FINAL bd", bd, flush=True)
print("SEQ", best, flush=True)
print("SS ", bs, flush=True)
